events.title: Live: Symbiosis: Criticality demo, one bit to criticality
events.summary: Live now: the free Symbiosis: Criticality demo, played start to finish. One core, one click, then drones, beams, ion arcs and a swarm you can still read. All the way until the reactor goes critical. The demo is free during Steam Next Fest. Grab it from the store page and play along.

events.title: The demo just grew up. New build is live.
events.summary: The demo on Steam just got the biggest update it's ever had. It's the build we're taking into Steam Next Fest in October, and it's the first one that teaches the game instead of dropping you in it. What's new since the last build The crash course. Ten levels that teach the reactor by having you run it. Hit the core, catch what falls, buy your first machine, watch it start working without you.
